The Android app opens Buy Me a Coffee in the browser. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ⚡ Improved

- **Buy Me a Coffee opens in the browser on the phone,** like PayPal, instead of in a window inside the app. The privacy policy says so.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The Apps page links the current APK.** Its Android download pointed at the 1.6.0 APK in 1.6.1 and 1.6.2, because the committed web bundle still carried the old version.
